warnings: *** THE TITLE SAYS 'ตัวอย่างการจัดวาง' -- AN EXAMPLE LAYOUT. NOTHING ON THIS SHEET IS A CONTRACT ITEM. *** Every furniture element carries indicative_layout_only and none should ever reach a bill of quantities. It is the same footprint and the same room tags as A-05; only the furniture is added.

NO FURNITURE IS DIMENSIONED and no schedule accompanies it, so sizes cannot be recovered -- only presence and rough position. Counts are read off the drawn symbols and are reliable only where the symbols are separated (the six dining chairs); elsewhere they are approximate.

The sheet is still useful for one thing: it shows the A-03 brief's clearances being tested against real furniture -- the bed with its clear side, the L-shaped kitchen run, and the turning space left in the living area.
Floor levels repeat A-05 exactly (+0.40 house, +0.38 wet areas and terrace, +0.10 car port, +0.00 drive). No new level information.
Room tags here are SIMPLER than on A-05: name and level only, with no floor-finish or ceiling number. Do not read the absence as a change of finish -- A-05 is the authority for finishes.
